subject: Service account delegation and privilege census for SOC2 scoping
messages:
From: Amanda Cross <amanda.cross@complianthealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: service account delegation + privilege census for SOC2 scope

Marcus / Laura —

We're kicking off the SOC 2 scoping for CompliantHealth (Sigma Partners is the auditor). To complete the access-control evidence collection they asked for a few specific artifacts related to service accounts, delegated privileges, and role ownership. Can you help with the following?

1) A census of all non-human accounts (service principals, service accounts, automation users) active in the tenant for the past 12 months, CSV preferred. Include: account id, display name, owner (email), last-used timestamp, linked service, and whether it has privileged roles.

2) A mapping of privileged roles (admin / owner / iam-admin / elevated) to named owners and role assignment timestamps.

3) SCIM delta samples showing provisioning/deprovisioning events for service accounts (the auditor wants a representative 2-week sample).

4) SAML assertion samples for a successful service-to-service assertion (time-window, audience, and sample assertion redacted).

5) Any delegation/run-as configurations (impersonation/delegated admin) and the justification logs or ticket ids where those were approved.

We realize some of this touches multiple teams; if you can point us to an internal export or share the artifacts, that will speed the audit. Also note Sigma needs the deliverables by 2027-08-27 to meet their timelines.

I've attached a checklist PDF with auditor field IDs to map outputs to. If you'd like, Procurement is on standby to sign an access attestation.

Thanks —
Amanda
Amanda Cross
Security & Compliance Lead, CompliantHealth
amanda.cross@complianthealth.com

Attachment: sig-questionnaire-extract-request.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Cross <amanda.cross@complianthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: service account delegation + privilege census for SOC2 scope

Hi Amanda —

Thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. We're on it. Quick notes and clarifying questions so we can scope deliverables properly: 

- We can produce the service-account census as a CSV. We'll include the fields you listed plus a column for "provisioning_source" (how the account was created) and "last_token_issue" where available. 

- Privileged role mapping: our RBAC stores multiple assignment types (direct, group-based, role-binding). Do you want both direct assignments and group-derived effective privileges? Auditor preference?

- SCIM delta samples: we have a 14-day delta export we can redact; we'll include timestamps and the performing actor.

- SAML assertion samples: we can provide redacted samples and a short narrative describing the token lifecycle. Are you OK with redacting PII and keeping only assertion fields auditors require (audience, issuer, attributes)?

- For delegation/impersonation: we have a short runbook and an approvals ledger (ticket IDs). I'll pull the approved delegation cases for the last 12 months.

Proposed delivery plan (we can tighten if Sigma needs earlier):
  - Draft CSV census + privilege mapping: 2027-08-24 EOD
  - SCIM delta + SAML samples + delegation ledger: 2027-08-25
  - Final bundled artifacts + readme (mapping to auditor checklist): 2027-08-26

I'll attach a template CSV (privilege-census-template.csv) for your review — helps ensure the auditor can map columns. Jordan, Laura: assigning to you to pull exports and validate owners.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: privilege-census-template.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amanda Cross <amanda.cross@complianthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: service account delegation + privilege census for SOC2 scope

Folks —

I've located the exports that will cover most of the ask. Quick notes and where I'll drop artifacts: 

1) Service account census export: stored in our secure drive folder (link below). It contains last_activity, creation_source, created_by ticket id where available. I will run a last-used enrichment job to fill last_token_issue.

2) RBAC mapping: We can produce both direct assignments and an "effective role" view (group expansion). Effective view will be the auditor-friendly one — I'll include both CSVs, label them accordingly.

3) SCIM deltas: I've created a redaction script to remove user-identifying attributes from delta samples; sample JSONs will be safe for auditor ingestion.

4) SAML assertion samples: security team can redact PII and provide example assertions with attribute list; note that assertion retention is short, so samples will be generated from logged captures.

Draft artifacts will be uploaded to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDriveFolderExample?usp=sharing (folder: /Audits/CompliantHealth/SOC2-2027). SFTP drop is also possible on request.

Jordan: can you run the last-used enrichment and start the privilege-owner lookup? I will coordinate redaction and documentation.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDriveFolderExample?usp=sharing

From: Amanda Cross <amanda.cross@complianthealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@complianthealth.com>, Sigma Partners <audits@sigma-partners.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: service account delegation + privilege census for SOC2 scope

Marcus / Laura —

This looks great, thanks. A couple small clarifications from Sigma: 

- For the privilege mapping, they want the effective role view (group expansion) as primary, and direct-assignments as supplemental.
- For SCIM deltas, include the actor (who performed the change) and the change reason if present.
- SAML samples: redacting PII is fine; please include assertion timestamps and audience.

Procurement will follow up on the attestation — if you need a signed form to grant auditor read-only access to the Drive folder, loop us in.

Again, target 2027-08-26 for the final bundle is fine. If anything slips, please flag immediately so we can adjust the auditor schedule.

Amanda
